title: Alternative cementitious materials for sulfate exposure.
officialText:
Combinations of cementitious materials for use in sulfate-
resistant concrete that are alternative to those listed in ACI 318, Table 4.3.1 shall be permitted in accordance with ACI 318,
Section 4.5.1.
SECTION BC 1905
CONCRETE QUALITY, MIXING AND PLACING
